blocks.tamil_translation: your sins will be forgiven, and you will be protected from evils.” Hazrat Abu Umamah Bahili (RA) narrated that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: ثَلَاثَةٌ يُحِبُّهُمُ اللهُ وَيَضْحَكُ إِلَيْهِمْ وَيَسْتَبْشِرُ بِهمْ: الَّذِي إِذَا انْكَشَفَتْ فِئَةٌ قَاتَلَ وَرَاءَهَا بِنَفْسِهِ لِلّهِ فَإِمَّا أَنْ يُقْتَلَ وَإِمَّا أَنْ يَنْصُرَهُ اللهٌ وَيَكْفِيَهُ فَيَقُولُ: انْظُرُوا إِلَي عَبْدِي هذَا كَيْفَ صَبَرَ لِي بِنَفْسِهِ؟ وَالَّذِي لَهُ امْرَأَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ وَفِرَاشٌ لَيِّنٌ حَسَنٌ فَيَقُومُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَيَقُولُ: يَذَرُ شَهْوَتَهُ وَيَذْكُرُنِي وَلَوْشَاءَ رَقَدَ، وَالَّذِي إِذَا كَانَ فِي سَفَرٍ وَكَانَ مَعَهُ رَكْبٌ فَسَهِرُوا ثُمَّ هَجَعُوا فَقَامَ مِنَ السَّحَرِ فِي ضَرَّاءَ وَسَرَّاءَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الطبراني في الكبير باسناد حسن الترغيب:٤٣٤/١
blocks.tamil_translation: “There are three persons whom Allah loves, and on seeing them He is delighted beyond measure. The first of them is the one who, even after all his companions have fled the battlefield, stands alone and fights seeking the pleasure of Allah. Then he may become a Shaheed, or, if Allah helps him, he may attain victory. Allah says (to the angels), “Look at this slave of Mine! How, seeking My pleasure, he stands firm alone on the battlefield and fights!” The second person is the one who, though he has a beautiful wife beside him and a soft bed as well, (leaves all of these and) engages in the Tahajjud Salah. Allah says, “Look! Leaving his desires, he has engaged himself in remembering Me; had he wished, he could have slept!” The third person is one who travels with a group; after the group stay awake late into the night and then fall asleep, he alone, in the last part of the night, whether his heart is willing or unwilling, stands for the Tahajjud Salah.” This is what
